scientific_role: Post-freeze/post-reveal robustness audit of already frozen Final-B3 and B6-P01A scores. No representation is refit, selected, reversed, or tuned.
motivation: Both-empty slice Dice equals 1.0. The strong simple mask-change baseline observed in B6-P01A may therefore be influenced by empty-slice geometry; this audit tests that possibility without changing any score.

strata.GT_EMPTY: historical CM6 GT packed mask has zero foreground
strata.GT_NONEMPTY: historical CM6 GT packed mask has foreground
strata.SOURCE_EMPTY: Final-B1 current-runtime SOURCE hard mask has zero foreground
strata.SOURCE_NONEMPTY: Final-B1 current-runtime SOURCE hard mask has foreground
strata.SOURCE_FOREGROUND_SIZE: SOURCE-empty is kept separate; for SOURCE-nonempty rows, family-specific Q1-Q4 cutpoints are estimated from Prostate158 Final-B1 SOURCE foreground fractions and applied unchanged to PROMISE12.
strata.SOURCE_DICE: Post-reveal explanatory quartiles within PROMISE12 model family, derived from frozen Final-B3 SOURCE Dice. Non-deployable explanatory analysis.

primary_sensitivity.reason: directly tests whether the main ranking signal is dominated by both-empty slices
primary_sensitivity.required_comparison: FULL_TRANSITION_SAFETTA versus SOURCE_PLUS_SIMPLE_MASK_CHANGE on fixed scores

statistics.single_class_rule: A cell with one HARM class is invalid for AUROC. Bootstrap replicates missing both classes in any point-valid cell are marked invalid; no 0.5 substitution.

interpretation_rules: If simple mask-change remains stronger on GT-nonempty slices, report it; do not rescue semantic transition.
If the simple baseline advantage collapses on GT-nonempty slices, describe empty-slice sensitivity explicitly.
Historical Final-B3 primary result remains the prespecified primary result regardless of this post-reveal audit.
